character.name: Clisty Farhal
character.appearance:
She has pale as snow skin, bright blue eyes and straight, thin, purple hair.
- She weras a big green hoodie, jeans and in Part one grey socks, in Part two she wears dark boots).
character.personality:
- she is very creative and can be a bit annoying at times. She would do anything to save all humans.
- Often she acts rather cold and careless over herself, but she tends to hide it by trying to be as polite as possible.
- She is also a very curious person. She is bisexual and asexual. She also loves the comic series 'Aquavia'.
character.backstory:
- she was the first child of a duke.
- It was her who had the grandious idea to use a spell at the mysterious kid.
- Seeing all of her partners die over the hundred of years led her to a slight jealousy over Delyria and Hestya, as well as she decided not to bond to anyone as long as she isn't sure she would even break the promise to the other witches just for that person.
- When she was banned to the magic prision, in 2018, she asked for the favour to have no memory.
- After being trapped there for about (twelve years??) she accidentally brought Bryan there.
- She fell in love with him but wasn't 100 percent sure of it.
- When they tried to escape two years later she wanted to choose death when she died after Bryan but Lukas stopped and possessed her.
- Together in a body they escaped. After three years and after Delyria and Hestya died she sacrifed her body to Lukas in order to finally be able to die and have peace.
